id.description: A random Uuid string for the cache invalidation message

typ.description: The type that will be invalidated, e.g. App

action.description: The action that will be broadcast to the other nodes, e.g. CacheInvalidator#evictLocal

key.description: The key that will be evicted from the cache

cache.description: The methodName of the cache Ex: rawJsonNativeCache or nativeCache

level.description: The specific level that the invalidation will occur on

sourceServerId.description: Location that the cache queue entry is originating from.

sourceAppId.description: AppId that the cache queue entry is originating from.

user.description: Id of the user who initiated the cache broadcast.
